endpoint: 100*(sample SD bilinear/sample SD matched drop - 1), all paired valid windows, fixed trained Gaussian widths
starResampling: With replacement within each tile. Each draw of a star includes all its valid windows and every method, aperture and calibration. Same base star draws across parities, with zero contribution for ineligible stars.
regionResampling: Enumerate all 4^4 ordered draws of tiles with replacement. Also omit each tile once. Windows retain original weights.
decision: Stable direction requires both percentile intervals and every leave-one-tile estimate strictly on the same side of zero. Per contrast descriptive, no multiplicity or independent-field inference.
scope: Same Bayer field and poses, radius match only; no PixInsight admission or scientific closure.
